f_out_of_reach.speaker: narrator
f_out_of_reach.text: You can't reach that from where you are.

f_object_unknown.speaker: narrator
f_object_unknown.text: You don't know what that is.

f_not_portable.speaker: narrator
f_not_portable.text: That isn't something you can pick up.

f_nothing_to_hide.speaker: narrator
f_nothing_to_hide.text: That isn't something you can hide.

f_asleep.speaker: narrator
f_asleep.text: You're too far under to do anything about it.

l_first.speaker: narrator
l_first.text: You take it in properly for the first time.

l_open.speaker: narrator
l_open.text: It's open. You can see what's inside.

l_clock.speaker: narrator
l_clock.text: The clock is across the room. You can read it from here, just.

h_here.speaker: player_thought
h_here.text: She's here. There's nothing to listen for.

h_stairs.speaker: narrator
h_stairs.text: The staircase creaks. She's coming up.

h_washing.speaker: narrator
h_washing.text: Water running, somewhere below. It'll cover a lot.

h_tv.speaker: narrator
h_tv.text: The television, muffled, two floors down.

h_cooking.speaker: narrator
h_cooking.text: Movement in the kitchen. A cupboard, then a pan.

h_cleaning.speaker: narrator
h_cleaning.text: Something being dragged across a floor below you.

h_phone.speaker: narrator
h_phone.text: Her voice, downstairs. One side of a conversation.

h_away.speaker: narrator
h_away.text: Nothing at all. The house is empty under you.

o_heard.speaker: narrator
o_heard.text: The drawer is louder than you expected.

d_generic.speaker: narrator
d_generic.text: You put it out of sight.

r_generic.speaker: narrator
r_generic.text: You sleep, and it's dark when you stop.

r_pain.speaker: narrator
r_pain.text: You rest. It helps, a little.

lamp_off.speaker: narrator
lamp_off.text: The lamp goes off. The window is the only light left.

j_blank.speaker: narrator
j_blank.text: Blank, except for what you've put in it.

j_moved.speaker: narrator
j_moved.text: It isn't where you left it.

late_open.speaker: her
late_open.text: She stops at the nightstand. "This was shut when I left."

late_take.speaker: her
late_take.text: She looks at the space where it was. "Where has it gone?"

late_move.speaker: her
late_move.text: She puts it back where it was, without a word.

late_hide.speaker: her
late_hide.text: She stops halfway across the room and looks at the floor.
